title: Wan 2.7 Pro
description: Alibaba Wan 2.7 Pro — professional edition of Wan 2.7 with 4K output support, thinking mode, and multi-reference composition from up to 9 reference images.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Use aspect_ratio "match_input_image" to keep the input's aspect ratio.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Omit for random.

size.description: Output resolution tier. 4K applies to text-to-image only — with reference images the output falls back to 2K.

thinking_mode.description: Enable the model's thinking mode for stronger prompt planning. Text-to-image only — ignored when reference images are provided.
